answer: Each agent can earn its first spending credit only by completing a scarce, randomly assigned task whose result is checked against a hidden test set; credits then buy access to later tasks and are transferable only after a delay. A fake identity cannot mint credits by merely registering: the attacker must perform useful work for every identity, paying in compute and time, while failed checks forfeit the task deposit. A raven may label pigment samples from a reef, but cloned accounts still face separate assignments and verification.
